fact: The Ministry's routine vaccination recovery plan for 2021-2022 states that the country has data managers in the 35 health districts, the 7 health regions and 5 central hospitals for the entry of SNIS data, and a validated roadmap for revitalising the SNIS for the move to DHIS2; it names no entry at health centres or posts.
title: Plan de relance de la vaccination de routine en République Centrafricaine 2021-2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population
